title: T2S Lexicon Entry Schema
description: Contract between P1 (data pipeline) and P2 (backend). Each entry in the lexicon JSON array must conform to this schema.

lemma.description: Canonical Arabic dictionary form (uninflected). Used as the primary key for lookup.

arabic_text.description: Display form of the word/phrase as shown to users.

video_filename.description: Filename of the video in the sign-videos storage bucket. P2 constructs the full storage_url.

is_compound.description: TRUE if this is a multi-word compound phrase (e.g., 'رئيس الوزراء').

word_count.description: Number of Arabic words in the lemma. 1 for single words, 2+ for compounds.

duration_ms.description: Optional: video duration in milliseconds, if known.

storage_url.description: Optional: full public video storage URL when P1 provides it directly.
